description: One or more sections with every file they need (fundations, icons, placeholder images), each with the path to write it to. Shared files are sent once. Ask for the whole page in one call. format 'tsx' returns React components (Next, Vite, Remix), format 'html' flat HTML with the Tailwind classes expanded (Vue, Svelte, plain HTML). Both are standalone sections only; parts have no flat export.

format.description: astro (default): .astro components with fundations. tsx: React components, no props, classes expanded. html: flat HTML, classes expanded.

have.description: Install paths already written in this project; they are omitted from the reply.

ids.description: Section ids from search_sections, in page order, e.g. ['brightlight/hero-1', 'brightlight/faq-1']

name: get_sections
